entries.zh: 灾难；苦难、厄运（17世纪西语 trabajos 一词亦指磨难、艰辛）
entries.notes: L栏圈注「trabajador darlo~」疑为 trabajos/dolores（磨难、悲苦）之误切分，与 H 灾难 相合但非清晰互证。
本行 L 栏空白，所属圈注第二行与「火灾」语义不合，en 依汉字与语境定。

entries.zh: 工；做工之人、工匠；亦指工事、活计
工夫；劳作、活计；亦指时间、空闲（旧义两通，此处从劳作义）
entries.en: work, labor, task; also leisure, spare time (17th-c. sense)
entries.notes: L 栏空白，「工夫」旧兼劳作/闲暇二义，依本页 trabajador 词族取劳作为先。

entries.en: to work, to do labor (for hire)
entries.notes: L 栏空白，M 栏多出一音节（côi）未得解释；释义依 H 做工。

entries.zh: 做工夫；做工干活、下力气做事
entries.en: to work, to labor, to apply oneself
entries.notes: M 栏首有「y.」记号未明，L 栏空白；释义依 H 做工夫与同页词族。

entries.zh: 工业（叠读作「工工业业」）；恒业、平日经常操持的营生
entries.en: habitual, ordinary occupation; one who works steadily (trabajador ordinariamente)
entries.notes: 前两音节声调记号 T99（污损难辨），字义依 H 工业与 L ordinariamente 推定。

entries.zh: 损气；劳损气力、累伤元气（操劳过度而伤身）
entries.en: to strain or exhaust one's vitality (qi); wearied with work (cansado)

entries.zh: 劳落（当即「劳碌」）；操劳辛苦、奔忙不歇
工夫人；佣工、按日受雇做工之人
做工夫人；受雇做工之人、打工度日者
entries.en: hired worker, one who works for wages (trabajador jornalero)

entries.zh: 匠催人（第二字原件存疑，或为「佣」）；雇匠、受雇之匠人
entries.en: hired craftsman, artisan for hire (trabajador jornalero); second character uncertain, possibly 佣
entries.notes: 封存件即标注 [疑]：第二字字形未定，释义据 M 栏音写与 L 栏 jornalero 推为受雇匠人。

entries.zh: 急计人〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕；字面为「急计之人」，与西栏 trabajador grande（旁注 soltero，未婚者）不合，无法定夺
entries.en: literal sense 'a hasty-scheming person'; Spanish column reads trabajador grande with side-note soltero (bachelor) — columns do not corroborate 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.notes: 四栏互不相证：H 急计 与 L grande/soltero 无法调合，语义无法定夺。

entries.en: to associate with, to form friendship (trabará amistad); to hand over, to intersect (secondary senses)
to tie, to knot; to form or forge a friendship (trabar amistad)

entries.zh: 结义兄弟；结拜为兄弟、义结金兰之交
entries.en: to become sworn brothers, to contract a great and binding friendship (trabar grande amistad)
to form friendship, to befriend (trabar amistad)
